description: BLAST, the Balloon-borne Large Aperture Submillimeter Telescope, was a stratospheric 2 m survey telescope with a three-band bolometer camera at 250, 350 and 500 microns.
short_description: BLAST balloon submillimetre telescope bands at 250, 350, 500 μm
facility_description: BLAST flew on long-duration stratospheric balloons, including flights from Kiruna in 2005 and McMurdo Station in 2006.
notes: The abstract says microns. NJM's keys are 250mic, 350mic and 500mic. No requested acknowledgement was found. The only reuse terms opened for the article are the arXiv non-exclusive licence, which does not grant further reuse and says to contact the author. That is not a grant to redistribute a separate numeric curve. No magnitude system was recorded.
